issues.summary: Hanseatic Marine Lines invoiced USD 900 detention for container HMLU6066254 (40HC), MBL HMLU260592, as the empty was returned 6 days after the 7-day free time (2 days typhoon terminal closure, 4 days Rapid Haul dispatch backlog).
The USD 900 detention case for HMLU6066254 was not escalated to the Import Team Lead within 48 hours and was only discovered via the May KPI report.

decisions.summary: Dispute 2 of the 6 detention days on HMLU6066254 with Hanseatic Marine Lines due to the typhoon terminal closure.
Bill Rapid Haul Logistics for the other 4 detention days on HMLU6066254 caused by their dispatch backlog.
Payment of the disputed portion of the USD 900 detention invoice is to be held until the carrier responds.
Jiwoo Han handed over the carrier dispute with Hanseatic Marine Lines on HMLU6066254 to Daniel Cho ahead of leaving on 30 June.
Jiwoo Han handed over issuing the debit note to Rapid Haul Logistics for 4 detention days on HMLU6066254 to Junho Oh.

tasks.summary: Hold payment of the disputed 2-day portion of the USD 900 detention invoice for HMLU6066254 until Hanseatic Marine Lines responds.
Pursue the 2-day typhoon closure dispute with Marcus Keller at Hanseatic Marine Lines through to a revised invoice or credit for HMLU6066254.
Issue a debit note to Kyungho Nam at Rapid Haul Logistics for 4 of 6 detention days on HMLU6066254, with the carrier detention invoice as backup.
Ensure detention cases are escalated to the Import Team Lead within 48 hours going forward.
